 -versus-

 Coram:
 Justice Chittaranjan Dash
 Order
Order No. 21.06.2023
02. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.
2. This is an application for bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s.420/120-B IPC read with Section 6 of the OPID Act.

3. The Petitioner allegedly involved in the offence under Section 6 of the OPID Act besides the offence under Section 420/120-B IPC for having conspired with one Debasis Mishra and his wife Rashmi Ranjan Mishra in misleading the poor Scheduled Tribe inhabitants of Gunupur by enticing them to extend loan facilities from the financiers and having so allured got the loan amount utilized under the pretext that they would deposit the installments as against the repayment whereas the poor villagers having fallen to the trap of the conspirators could know about the intention of the Petitioner, // 2 // the said Debasis Mishra and his wife.

As alleged the said persons including the Petitioner extended threat to the villagers and also assured them to pay the installments and will manage with the financiers whereas nothing happened as assured as the financer kept demanding payment of installments.

When the villagers approached the said Debasis Mishra and his wife, the Petitioner taking the lead assured the informant and other beneficiaries not to be worried and to manage whereas he managed the said Debasis Mishra and his wife to move out of Gunupur.

Later the informant and others who are poor tribal people became victim of the conspiracy of the Journalist who allegedly to have managed in extending the loan and utilized the same being one of the members of the conspiracy.

sentences.text:
4. The statements of Mrudulata Mandangi, Gayani Sabar, Santosh Sabar, Rajendra Kumbhrika and Santosh Kumar Gouda who have narrated the manner in which they have been put to trap giving rise to the offence under Section 6 of the OPID Act and the description made in the statements that clearly attracts the definition under sub clause (a) of Section 2 of the OPID Act it includes the body corporate and firm or other association of individuals.
5. The seizure of the bank passbook in respect to Kumurika Jayanti, Pramila Taika, Saraswati Palaka, Rina Palaka, Damayanti Mandangi, Kalabati Kumburika, Patika Jasoda, Shanti Patika,
Mamata Toika and Palaka Sujata standing in different banks prima facie reveals transaction of money in several other such accounts have also been seized in connection with the matter.

As far as the present Petitioner is concerned, it is alleged that he is engaged in pulling various officers in Government department, shop keepers, // 3 // educational institutions and taking advantage of being a media person collecting/extorting huge money in the name of Gunupur Naba Nirman Samiti whereas the money so collected has never been accounted for though it involves public money in large scale.

6. It is submitted by Mr. Palit, learned senior counsel appearing for the Petitioner that the allegation does not reveal the present Petitioner to be any way connected with the alleged offence either in alluring the beneficiaries in extending loan or that he utilized the money.

According to Mr. Palit the stray sentence in the statement of the witnesses to the effect that the Petitioner assured them to make good the deposits and to manage the financier would no way bring him within the ambit of Section 6 of the OPID Act.
7. Having regard to the nature of allegation which involves the poor tribal of the area in huge number need a proper investigation.
The Petitioner is, therefore, directed to appear before the Investigating Officer on 26th June, 2023 to receive further instruction.
8. As an interim measure, it is directed that no coercive step be taken against the Petitioner till the next date.
List this matter on 10th July, 2023.
The Petitioner is directed to cooperate the investigating agency in all respect and shall no way sabotage the investigation influencing his position as Journalist.
The Learned Counsel for the state to place the up to date case diary and the nature of involvement the Petitioner.

(Chittaranjan Dash) Judge KC Bisoi KRUSHNA Digitally KRUSHNA signed by CHANDRA CHANDRA BISOI Date: 2023.06.22 BISOI 18:39:01 +05'30'
